topic.title: Opening a File as Read-Only in Web Author

body.p: When a file is open as read-only, visually warns users that they cannot edit the document. This prevents users from editing content only to receive an error when they try to check it in or save it.

You can instruct the to open a file as read-only by using one of the following methods:
If you are implementing a URLStreamHandler plugin, you can implement the java.net.URLConnection.getHeaderField(String) method to return the value of true for the oxygen_read_only header name. The following headers provide with additional details about why the document is read-only:
oxygen_read_only_reason Provides the reason why a document is read-only. The reason appears when the user tries to edit the document.
oxygen_read_only_reason_code Provides a code that identifies why the document is read-only. The code must be unique across user interface languages. It is not shown to the user, but it is available through the API.
Use the JavaScript API editor.setReadOnlyState().
Use the Java API ro.sync.ecss.extensions.api.access.AuthorEditorAccess#setReadOnly().
In read-only mode, Web Author displays a warning stripe that explains why the document is read-only. You can customize the stripe's content with the editor.setReadOnlyStripeRenderer() JavaScript API.
